units.source: Hoisting is a standard outliner feature which allows you to focus on (or "zoom into") a specific note and its subtree by hiding all parent and sibling notes. Demo:
In addition to showing only this subtree, this also narrows both full text search and __TRILIUM_PH_0__“jump to note”__TRILIUM_PH_1__ to just notes present in hoisted subtree.

units.context: Note Hoisting > Showing all notes again

units.source: While a note is hoisted, the desktop interface shows a __TRILIUM_PH_0__Show all notes__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button with the __TRILIUM_PH_2__ icon above the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Note Tree__TRILIUM_PH_4__. Click it to unhoist the note and see the whole tree again.
units.context: Note Hoisting > Showing all notes again

units.source: On a phone, the back button at the top level of the hoisted tree turns into a __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button, followed by the hoisted note's title. Tap it to unhoist the note; the tree then shows the level holding the hoisted note, as one more step up.
units.context: Note Hoisting > Showing all notes again

units.source: See also __TRILIUM_PH_0__Workspace__TRILIUM_PH_1__ which extends this feature.
